verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly's docs say the Relay Proxy connects to the LaunchDarkly streaming API, which confirms first-party streaming delivery of flag changes. Multiple hands-on users report that SDK clients download all flags on connect, then stream changes via server-sent events with minimal latency. The report of 3s API timeouts concerns lookup latency, not propagation, so it does not contradict this. Missing for 10: first-party SDK streaming/polling documentation with stated propagation latency ("seconds"), explicit kill-switch documentation, and independent measurement of how fast kill-switch changes take effect.

support.subject: As a developer, flag changes propagate to connected SDKs in seconds via streaming or fast polling — a kill switch actually kills
